# Development of a conceptual model that links digital transformation to the responsible use of massive data generated by the client

The digital transformation has become one of the main priorities of the companies, since in facing an increasingly complex, competitive and changing business environment, they need to adapt, innovate, adopt technologies and implement important structural and cultural changes. The revised literature allowed to establish what are the most important dimensions, variables and objectives to take into account if a process of these is planned. The purpose of this study is to strengthen the understanding of digital transformation and to design a conceptual model that relates to the responsible use of the data. To achieve this purpose, a case study methodology was used to know the perception of the directors of a large Colombian company, with respect to the links made in the model. The findings suggest that defining a clear and holistic strategy is fundamental to properly target the achievement of the desired objectives in the transformation. This document provides a comprehensive and profound vision of the digital transformation and provides a regulatory framework for companies to be able to navigate through this process. . This paper provides a broad and deep view of digital transformation and offers a policy framework for companies to guide them in shipping through this process
